caption: The drawing depicts a single metal spur placed horizontally against a plain, off-white or light beige background. The spur is colored in shades of brown and gray, giving it a metallic and worn appearance. It consists of a U-shaped main body with two rectangular loops at one end, which are attached to the band. The band has a jagged edge and a smooth edge, and is fastened with a visible rivet or bolt. At the opposite end of the U- shaped body, there is a large spiked rowel with six sharply pointed, radiating spokes. The colors are muted and the illustration has a realistic texture, emphasizing the metallic and solid nature of the object. There is a minimalist signature or monogram from the artist in the bottom right corner of the composition.
title: Spur
